name: Trimble SketchUp
description:
The SketchUp connector for Claude turns a conversation into a 3D model. Describe what you want to build — a room addition, a piece of furniture, a site concept — and Claude will generate models for you to open, refine, and share. No modeling experience required to get started.

Upon setting up the connector, ask Claude to create a SketchUp model from text prompts, images, or other inputs. Preview models in Claude or open them in SketchUp to evaluate, iterate, or manually modify. Iterate with Claude and SketchUp to refine model versions as desired.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trimble SketchUp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trimble SketchUp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sketchup.com/mcp/v1/sketchup/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trimble SketchUp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trimble SketchUp provides these MCP tools: build_model, get_docs, and save_model.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trimble SketchUp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trimble SketchUp in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does Trimble SketchUp MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trimble SketchUp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trimble SketchUp is developed by Trimble SketchUp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
